newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Virgin sells ex-Brussels freight services.
newsitem.headline: Virgin sells ex-Brussels freight services.

text.p: Virgin Express said has started selling freight capacity on its Boeing 737 passenger flights between Brussels-Madrid and Brussels-Barcelona.
Brett Godfrey, Virgin Express general manager projects, said that by the end of April the company plans to expand these operations to other cities from Brussels.
"Virgin Express is being considered on the short-list of three international postal tenders of companies which include the Royal Mail in the UK," he told Reuters.
"If we get one or even part of these contracts we will consider other destinations such as Copenhagen, Rome, Milan, Vienna and London," said Godfrey.
Over the past three weeks, Virgin Express has begun moving cargo on behalf of Sabena, he added.
Virgin Express has a fleet of 14 737s.
"We are aiming to focus on express products and mail...anything that it easy to handle alongside our passenger services," said Godfrey.
